# Property listings: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Listings must state the energy rating of the building, per the Housing Disclosure Regulations. |
| C2 | Agents must not publish a listing without the owner's written consent, under the Estate Agents Code. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a product owner, I want every listing page to meet all the rules in this document so that we pass inspection.
US-2 As an agent, I want to add photos to a listing so that it attracts viewers.
US-3 As an agent, I want publishing blocked until the owner's signed consent is uploaded so that I never list a property without it.
US-4 As a buyer, I want to filter listings by price so that I see what I can afford.
